validation_method: For every changed staged path, compute the Git blob object hash from actual working bytes and compare with stage0 index OID. Also compare every selected archive member SHA256 with the current byte source and, where individually tracked, compare those bytes with the Git index.
self_reference_limit: This receipt is excluded from its own listed index snapshot and from the earlier pattern scan. It contains only this check metadata and generated file paths/hashes. After saving, root stages it and checks its actual blob bytes separately before committing.
commit_intent: Complete five-condition exploratory pilot with audited results
